NAME

socket_send_buffer_t

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/platform/socket.h>

Data Fields


void * data
size_t capacity
bool mapped
buffer_budget_t budget

Detailed Description

Owned send storage. Large Linux allocations use private mappings: unmapping after cancellation cannot recycle pages still pinned by the network stack. Other platforms and small allocations use owned buffers. All storage is budgeted.
